project_name: RAW AI Studio - Selección y edición IA de bodas

design_principles.fusion_over_imitation: Combine high-end Lightroom/Capture One pro-darkroom precision with sleek modern SaaS dashboard ergonomics and high-contrast tactile status indicators.
design_principles.emotion_first: Provide a high-focus, low-distraction studio environment for wedding photographers to process thousands of RAW files effortlessly.
design_principles.content_is_king: The wedding photograph is the hero. Neutral dark neutral backgrounds (#101012, #141414, #1E1E22) ensure absolute color perception.
design_principles.contrast_and_hierarchy: 1px crisp zinc borders, emerald green AI best-shot accents (#34D399 / emerald-400), and stark pure white primary CTAs with dark text.

fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

layout_and_grids.stepper_layout: Horizontal 8-step visual studio pipeline header with status icons, step numbers, progress indicators, and active stage glowing emerald highlights.
layout_and_grids.workspace_layout: 3-column pro photo suite layout: Left navigation/folder browser sidebar (col-span-3), Center canvas viewer/grid (col-span-6 or 7), Right parameter/preset panel (col-span-3).
layout_and_grids.bento_grid: Asymmetric bento grid for Project Dashboard and Final Report stats cards using gap-4 to gap-6 and rounded-xl containers with zinc-800 borders.
layout_and_grids.review_grid: Responsive photo grid (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3) with burst group indicators, green AI selection badges, and quick hotkey/click toggle controls.

visual_enhancers.card_styles: bg-[#141418] border border-zinc-800 hover:border-zinc-700 transition-all rounded-xl shadow-lg
visual_enhancers.slider_customization: Dark slider tracks with emerald filled range and sharp metallic handles for precision exposure/white balance/preset tuning.

framer_motion.page_transition: { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 8 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, exit: { opacity: 0, y: -8 }, transition: { duration: 0.25 } }
framer_motion.burst_expand: { layout: true, transition: { type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 25 } }

instructions_to_main_agent: Keep full Spanish interface throughout the app (buttons, titles, messages, tooltips, stats).

Support all 8 steps in the Studio Stepper: 1. Proyecto -> 2. Carpeta RAW -> 3. Selección IA -> 4. Revisión -> 5. Perfil de Cámara -> 6. Presets y Correcciones IA -> 7. Generación XMP -> 8. Reporte Final.
Implement actual downloadable ZIP package with real generated XML/XMP sidecar files using JSZip or synthetic Blob download for sidecars.
Provide mock Google Login / Sign-in state with user profile dropdown and studio credentials.
Ensure every clickable button, tab, card, input, and interactive control includes explicit data-testid attributes.
Use dark professional photography theme aesthetics exclusively (bg #101012, panels #141418, emerald #34D399 accents).
Use sonner for notifications (e.g. 'Proyecto guardado', 'XMP generado con éxito', 'Carpeta RAW cargada').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive_design: Ensure grid layouts adapt from mobile to multi-monitor desktop viewports.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent backgrounds on panels or dropdowns; always use elevated dark zinc or glassmorphic backdrop-blur.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_usage: Use sonner for toasts from /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or import { toast } from 'sonner'.
